notes.title: Football Club Simulator #21 “Free Update + Real Mod FCS #21” from PCFutbolmanía
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12177077/91f6040a91001f0f4dbcaef087d20cdb0961301a.jpg

Thanks to the passion of the gamer community, we can enjoy the new “Free Update + Real Mod FCS #21” that offers last transfer window data and all the news until the end of the season.

A free 526 GB Mod including real players, teams, shields, trophies, sponsors, and 7,500 players photos.

>>> Now available at Steamworks!!!

You are the boss

# 7 leagues, including first and second divisions of the following countries:
England, Spain, Italy, Germany, France, Mexico, and Argentina.

# 37 domestic and continental competitions from Europe and America.

# 619 teams from 51 countries all around the world.

# 16.124 players from 148 different nationalities.

# 7,500 players photos.

# 285.000 parameters for a reliable player rol.


About Football Club Simulator

# Football Club Simulator, the FX and Dinamic project to bring the spirit of “Old School” Premier Manager,  PCFútbol & PCCalcio to more than 100 countries around the world reaches 100,000 units.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12177077/67639f7997a57bd2f2d3edd4b33eb1319d4f01fc.jpg

# A casual football & strategy video game. A real-time simulation of your favourite football Club.
Agile, intuitive, fast... 

# Allows you to play seasons in hours, not days: line-up, training, tactics, youth squad, scout, transfers, stadium, highlights, Strategic matches.

# Created by Dinamic Games, our FCS Dev Team gathering their passion for football, data, and statistics

# Supported by the invaluable teamwork of the PCFutbolmanía gamer community, which grows up season by season.

# A team led by Gaby Ruiz, professional scout of Leeds United and game designer for the “Old School” Premier Manager, PCFútbol & PCCalcio.

notes.title: “Final Race Update” for FCS 18 presents the biggest collection of new features and improvements until now.
notes.notes:
And more important, all these updates have been achieved in collaboration with the players Community. 

 The new Football Club Simulator - FCS 18 has now a 70% discount and you can get it by less than 3$. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/324090/Football_Club_Simulator__FCS_18/

We are proud to count behind with an international player community  so committed to the continuous improvement  of Football Club Simulator - FCS.	

Every idea, suggestion, analisis, critic and/or experience related to the videogame is fundamental for the step by step improvement. Cheer up to participate!!! 

You can contact us by clicking on the SUGGESTIONS button on the game main menu:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/701b239c0e967453e2f9538b22d3c19ef2ebd373.jpg

Or by sending me a mail directly to: 

nataly.stefano@fxgamestudio.com

We are already working on the new version of the football and strategy videogame ready for the grand opening of the next season 18 /19. 


Changelog FCS 18 “Final Race Update” 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/eb23ee7090262ee14e0a2b4dc2c0c0027e479f14.jpg

Implemented suggestions from the Community

1. New players algorithm 
 “The new players appearing after the current players retirement have a very low level, sometimes even below 40. These players should be as good as the real ones and get better year after year as it happens in reality”. Implemented. 

Further details:
We have set up a new algorithm based on histograms: 

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Histogram

Each histogram represents the frequency of player’s levels depending on their field position on each of the leagues and divisions in Football Club Simulator - FCS 18.

For example, these are the histograms of different positions:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/ad87fdd8a4503d101425a1bf522b3731a2f7bbf1.jpg

By assigning the players the level based on these histograms, we know for sure that we maintain the level of the players and the leagues season after season.  

The algorithm takes into consideration the retiring player’s nationality as well so the amount of players for each country remains the same. 

Now it is time to implement this update and test it. We will be adjusting the algorithm with the help of your comments and feedback until it works to perfection. 

2. Improvement in the waiting time between fixtures 
 “Since FCS 17 the waiting time between screens have been reduced and it would be great if this tendency can be kept”. Implemented. 

Further details:
The optimisation of the searching algorithms used by the IA-controlled teams, in special in the areas related to the new hirings, allows us to improve the game.

When searching for a player with specific skills in the database, the average searching time will be directly proportional to the database size. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/9864a64a2d08ff83f82ff46ea08d4dcc5abe2a0f.jpg

However, if the database is divided in different slots and a map is created in order to locate the right slot for each time fast enough, the searching time is drastically reduced. This is how the new FCS 18 database #FR18 with HashMap works. 

We have also compared FCS 17 and FCS 18 waiting times while using as a parameter the most common PC among Steam players (4 CPUs and speed from 3.3 Ghz to 3.69 Ghz as registered in the last survey of April 2018):

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/d7c5350bdcfb4233f334ca6ed8f1527f68e3c8e8.jpg

This is the comparative times in seconds:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/0031b3c8f5f0b0cb0febdc48523b3c52bc70121b.jpg

Since the beginning of the season, we have achieved a reduction of around 18% on waiting times. We are on a good path. 

Still, we will keep working on the reduction of waiting times for the new FCS 19. We’ll keep you updated! 

3. More information between fixtures
“Currently, transition screens between fixtures don’t give you any information (next match information, for example) so it makes you wonder if the game is loading or has crashed instead. It would be great to receive any information while you wait”.  Implemented. 

Further details:
We have created the “Loading and Info” screen with the following elements: 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/4665c99da2f3fe16dd5085021a36d5660d79ab30.jpg

1. Loading symbol indicating that the process is on.
2. Trophy, name and flag of the competition of the following match.
3. Next fixture to be played.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/9afdfe84e3afeed1f78242ea35e06476a55bada5.jpg

We can include further information which you might find useful. 

Share your ideas with us!!! 

4. New database including the winter transfer window 
“It would be great to play with up-to-date squads: the new signings from the winter transfer window, the leagues with different transfer systems…”   Implemented. 

Further details:
We have updated the players database focusing on the following three goals: 

a) Include the winter window signings of each team and the new free players.

b) Include the signings of teams in leagues like Brazil and China with open transfer windows. 

c) Make FCS database bigger by adding more teams and players. After this update, more than 30 teams and 700 players will be added.

Here we have some examples of new teams from different continents: 

SC Heerenveen - Netherlands
Vasco da Gama - Brazil
Rangers FC - Scotland
LA Galaxy - USA
Millonarios FC - Colombia
Osmanlispor FK - Turkey
Dalian Yifang - China
KS Legia Gdansk - Poland
Real Garcilaso - Perú
Defensor SC - Uruguay
Cerro Porteño - Paraguay
Delfín SC - Ecuador
Monagas SC - Venezuela
RC Recreativo - Spain

5. Player pictures available in Community’s MODS 
“It would be a great improvement if we could add pictures of players in the Community’s MODs. Would it be possible?   Implemented. 

Further details:
The new “Real MOD FCS 18 #FR18 PCFutbolmanía” is now available in SteamWorks and the first images are already included. 

The Community has started with the faces of the Liverpool and Real Madrid players in honor of the Champions final, but the number will increase rapidly from week to week.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/930fd6ab29b58793be51d4904160de440f4d6cee.jpg

Here you have a small example of how the profiles can look:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/fae5b279da3356ed77cfbb976d8f3caca51ef972.jpg

6. Adjustments in the algorithm regarding the IA-controlled teams signings and the improvement of the squads.   Implemented.

7. Make the renewal of contracts less demanding.   Implemented.

8. The game should remember the last order parameters.   Implemented. 

9. Save the original pre-match tactics instead of save the tactics of the end of the match.   Implemented. 

10. Increase the moral after reaching your goals.  implemented.


 Bugs reported by the Community fixed now                                                                          

1. Possibility of editing the team system starting with any field position.    Fixed.

2. Limit of foreigners while making bids.   Fixed.

3. Players on loans should not be fired.   Fixed.

4. Duplicated bids from the same team and with different numbers.    Fixed.

5. Bug in Promanager games with two players.   Fixed.

6. Adjust Bundesliga schedule.   Fixed.

7. Money income for teams playing Copa Libertadores.   Fixed.

8. The salary cap must be respected by IA’s teams in Argentina and Mexico.   Fixed.


Do not hesitate to contact me addressing your questions related to Football Club Simulator - FCS:

nataly.stefano@fxgamestudio.com

notes.title: Mid season FCS 18 update (v3.5.1.5) includes 20 improvements suggested by the international gamers community.
notes.notes:
We are proud to count with an international gamers community behind so committed to the continuous improvement of Football Club Simulator - FCS.

Every idea, suggestion, analisis, critic and/or experience related to the videogame is fundamental for our improvement. 

Join now!!!

You can contact us by clicking on the SUGGESTIONS button on the game main menu:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/701b239c0e967453e2f9538b22d3c19ef2ebd373.jpg

Or by sending a mail directly to: nataly.stefano@fxgamestudio.com

We are already working on the version v3.6.1.0. Among many updates, it includes the winter window transfers. 


Changelog version FCS 18 - v3.5.1.5

Implemented Community Suggestions:

1. Quality of new players
The new players replacing the retiring ones are quite bad. These new players should have similar ratings to those who retire. Implemented 

2. New age ranges in Scouting
The search function would improve if the following ranges were implemented. From 15 to 19 years / from 20 to 24 years / from 25 to 29 years / from 30 to 34 years / from 35 years onwards. Implemented. 

3. Promising talents 
It would be very useful to have the assistant coach informing you on a monthly basis if any of your young talents is overperforming In the Football School, Additionally, it would be great if the assistant coach could report about good players in your Youth Squad who are not yet training. Implemented. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/2ca4ae9cceb95e3d704bad983144ff1a43ccb81f.jpg

4. More rotation 
The AI does not rotate the line-ups so sometimes the stars of the rival teams are too tired and that penalises the team. This should be improved for the CPU teams. Implemented. 

5. Form affecting the tiredness algorithm 
Tiredness would be more realistic if not only the number of matches played consecutively and the minutes played in each of them are taking into account but also the current form of the player. This would imply that the better the player’s form is, the slower the player tires. Implemented. 

6. Quick action in one-week injuries 
If a player has a one-week injury, the medical team should treat him so he is fit for the next game. Implemented. 

7. Adjustments of the tiredness of new signings
While it is normal that the signing of a new player implies extra tiredness, the level now is too high. It should be reduced so he can play from the first match. Implemented. 

8. Winning bid
In the cases where you receive more than one bid for one of your players, it would be useful that once you accept one of them, the rest of the bids are automatically removed. The game would gain in dynamism and clarity. Implemented. 

9. Form in Football School after summer break
When the new season starts, the quality loss of the young talents is too high. They are young so it should be easier for them to keep the form. Implemented. 

10. Search by nationality 
I’d definitely implement a new search option: nationality. It would be really useful for us Argentinians as our squads can only have 5 foreign players. It would be useful as well in leagues like the English or the German, where the squad must have a minimum of national players. Implemented. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/92107dd251c96a89e7674ef78af038552a85b725.jpg

11. More options in specific training 
I’d like to have more slots for the specific training of my players. With a one-star training coach, I have six slots. This is clearly not enough. Also, with the best of the training coaches, I cannot train all my players simultaneously. I think one-star coaches should come with at least 11 slots and a five-star coach should let you train all the squad at the same time. Implemented. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/12ba88c4e53319e6befbabface147e715f09b664.jpg

12. Better end-of-the-match ratings
The ratings at the end of the match could be more realistic if it took into account the performance based on the most important skills for each position along with the quality difference between the two teams. Implemented. 

13. Statistics of all leagues 
I love the statistics menu. It helps me in situations like choosing the tactics for important games or making transfers based on the information of the players and teams of my league. However, I would include the statistics of all the rest of leagues. Implemented. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/01030422c5b6685fdc3a2f4d3e420546b28176e4.jpg

14. Signed player message
If a player will sign for a new team in the next transfer window, it should be reflected on his profile (for example, in the section where the button “Sign” appears now. Implemented. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/67e7da1c82e3cd0a8455bf519b93448085876216.jpg

15. Message when the works in the stadium are finished 
Making the stadium bigger is one of my favourite options of the game. I just miss a message that informs me once the works are done. Implemented.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/ac0b74e0a2bc5917811e0c13823a9342cfdfa3b2.jpg

16. Improvement in the message “There is an interesting player”
It would be very useful if the message informing you that there is an interesting player is not removed even after you enter his profile so you can monitor him closely for the period of time you decide. The only way to close that message should be clicking the CLOSE button. Implemented.

17. New message about player wanting to get a better contract 
When a player has a salary which does not correspond with his quality, the game should let you know that he wants to either renew his contract or leave the team. Logically, if there is no agreement for a new contract, his performance will not be as good as usual. Implemented. 

18. New message about injuries 
I would implement a new message alerting you when one of your players has suffered an injury. Implemented. 

19. New message about players being fit again
Along with the previous message, the doctors should announce when the players are healthy again and ready to train and play.Implemented. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/80fc0c95a76a0269a43d328e0f44d72d6e92ac20.jpg

20. New rules for foreign players in Argentina 
Since January 2018, there is a new rule in Argentina. The clubs can sign up to six foreign players and up to five of them can play simultaneously (before this law, only 4 could play at the same time). It would be fantastic if this could be implemented in the game. Implemented.


Reported bugs by the community already fixed:

- Sometimes some players lose their skills very early in their careers (even at 27!). At that age, I think they should be still improving and not otherwise. Fixed.

- Sometimes, during the summer transfer window, I do not receive any offer for the players from my club listed in the transfer list. However, when the summer transfer window closes, offers start to pop up. Fixed.

- I had to play Barcelona in the third match of the preseason when actually I need to play them again in the Supercopa de España days later. Fixed.

- When an “interesting player” appears, it is usually the same player and almost every time is just a free-agent player. It would be good to have more variety. Fixed.

- In 2017, currently a match is set to play on Sunday December 31st. This is not adjusted to real life where there are no matches in Italy, Spain or France. Please adjust. Fixed.

- The free-agent players are not signed instantly. Fixed.

- In the “Injuries” screen, the form level is not readable. Fixed.

- In the Highlights mode, when a player is injured, there is no message alerting you of this situation so you can not make the substitution. Fixed.

- The players being substituted off the pitch are not rated. Fixed.

- When playing this game, my computer overheats and I need to use a cooling system. Fixed.

- Something strange happened to me. I noticed that some players on loans are at the same time transfered. The game does not allow your club to sign any loaned player but CPU clubs can and this should not be possible. Fixed.

- The foreign player rule in Argentina only applies to your club. Only your club is obliged not to play 5 foreign players at the same time and not to include 6 of them in your squad. But for what I have seen, the rest of clubs can have as many foreign players as they wish. Fixed.

- The Community Shield is played in the local team’s stadium. In real life, this match is played at Wembley. Fixed.

- The two Mexican Supercopas are played in the local team’s stadium. This competition is always played in a neutral field, either in Mexico or USA with a crowd capacity of at least 20 000 people. Fixed.

- Keepers in every league are displayed correctly in the statistics screen but not yours, even if he has played 70% of the matches. Fixed.

- When playing with the manual training option on, once you get rid of one player taking part of your training plan, the AI resets the training as if the automatic training option was on. Fixed.

- The loans are not saved. If you accept a loan for a player, when you load your game, the loan is not active. Fixed.

- I played Barcelona in the first leg of the Supercopa de España and they have made their three substitutions. In the last minute of the match, Umtiti has suffered an injury and Semedo has entered the pitch, becoming the fourth substitution. This should not happen, they should have played with only 10 players for the remaining part of the match. Fixed.

- Sometimes, in the Highlight mode, the AI has made a substitution taking an injured player off the bench. Even if they are on the bench, the AI should never choose injured players. Fixed.

- You should not play twice the same team in preseason. For example, playing with Real Madrid, I have played Werder Bremen both in the first match and in Trofeo Bernabéu. Fixed.

- Sometimes, when the rival keeper is sent off, the AI replaces him with a keeper from the bench and the team keeps playing with eleven players. When a keeper or a defense in the CPU team is sent off, the team should play with 10 players using a more defensive plan and adapt the players and tactics to the new situation. Fixed.

Do not hesitate to contact me addressing your questions related to Football Club Simulator - FCS to my new mail: 

nataly.stefano@fxgamestudio.com

Note: The mail account mail@footballclubsimulator.com does not work anymore. Please, use this new mail address. Thanks!!!

- When playing this game, my computer overheats and I need to use a cooling system. Fixed.

- Something strange happened to me. I noticed that some players on loans are at the same time transfered. The game does not allow your club to sign any loaned player but CPU clubs can and this should not be possible. Fixed.

- The foreign player rule in Argentina only applies to your club. Only your club is obliged not to play 5 foreign players at the same time and not to include 6 of them in your squad. But for what I have seen, the rest of clubs can have as many foreign players as they wish. Fixed.

- The Community Shield is played in the local team’s stadium. In real life, this match is played at Wembley. Fixed.

- The two Mexican Supercopas are played in the local team’s stadium. This competition is always played in a neutral field, either in Mexico or USA with a crowd capacity of at least 20 000 people. Fixed.

- Keepers in every league are displayed correctly in the statistics screen but not yours, even if he has played 70% of the matches. Fixed.

- When playing with the manual training option on, once you get rid of one player taking part of your training plan, the AI resets the training as if the automatic training option was on. Fixed.

- The loans are not saved. If you accept a loan for a player, when you load your game, the loan is not active. Fixed.

- I played Barcelona in the first leg of the Supercopa de España and they have made their three substitutions. In the last minute of the match, Umtiti has suffered an injury and Semedo has entered the pitch, becoming the fourth substitution. This should not happen, they should have played with only 10 players for the remaining part of the match. Fixed.

- Sometimes, in the Highlight mode, the AI has made a substitution taking an injured player off the bench. Even if they are on the bench, the AI should never choose injured players. Fixed.

- You should not play twice the same team in preseason. For example, playing with Real Madrid, I have played Werder Bremen both in the first match and in Trofeo Bernabéu. Fixed.

- Sometimes, when the rival keeper is sent off, the AI replaces him with a keeper from the bench and the team keeps playing with eleven players. When a keeper or a defense in the CPU team is sent off, the team should play with 10 players using a more defensive plan and adapt the players and tactics to the new situation. Fixed.

Do not hesitate to contact me addressing your questions related to Football Club Simulator - FCS to my new mail: 

nataly.stefano@fxgamestudio.com

Note: The mail account mail@footballclubsimulator.com does not work anymore. Please, use this new mail address. Thanks!!!

notes.title: July FCS 17 Update (v3.4.1.1) made from Football Club Simulator - FCS 17 player's suggestions: Real time squad planning and new rival AI.
notes.notes:
Afterward the release of Football Club Simulator - FCS 17 on June 2nd we keep on working for improving the videogame teaming up with worldwide FCS gamers community. 
 
Do not hesitate to write us with your ideas: mail@footballclubsimulator.com

We count on you all to achieve successfully FCS 18 (v3.5) including new season 2017 / 2018 free DLC targeted for early September. 
 
 Real time squad planning  
Having the best squad is key in order to achieve the Club's objectives.
 
And this is the reason why we have expanded up to five tabs that give you information about how to plan your squad:

Current squad 
Additions
On loan
Winter Market
Next season

Now you have perfectly clear the players you have at your disposal. The ones you have, the ones you are going to have, which ones are on loan and what your team will be in both the winter and next season markets.
 
You can also keep track of your transferred players, to know how they are doing, if they improving, if they are playing...
 
The real-time control of the squad knowing in detail the squad you have and the squad you'll have is an essential help to set your priorities at the time of transfer. 

 New rival AI  
In every game, your opponent will choose the game plan and the balance that best outcome offers to deal with your team and your tactics.
 
The AI will also undertake the best starters for each game plan, it will review and perform rotations and, among all the possible combinations, opt for the one offering a higher RTA.
 
If you play against an inferior rival, it will seek to close lines and place more defensive players. If on the other hand, you play against a top team, it will accumulate players in offensive positions to play the attack.
 
In short, the new IA of your rivals enhances the gaming experience by making it more realistic and challenging. 

 Suggestions from the Community 
“It would be nice to have the data of fatigue when performing a substitution” Implemented.
 
“The search criteria by age of the scout is 17 to 19 years. Having watched this season signings, it would need to be expanded from 16 to 19”  Implemented.
 
The notice of "unanswered" should appear only in the "aggressive" offers that pay the clause and therefore that might end up taking the player. Implemented.

  Bugs reported by the Community 
“On certain occasions, when search with the scout has been performed, the game has not been able to continue” Corrected.
 
“I receive the message "Not enough players" but I have do have enough players in the squad” Corrected.
 
“The number 0 dorsal appears to be available and it shouldn't be because it is not regulatory” Corrected.
 
“In the middle of a game, you can press the + button of Personalised Training. It would be necessary to lock the button in these cases” Corrected.

notes.title: New price, new offer of 50% and new free main update made with the suggestions of the Football Club Simulator - FCS players.
notes.notes:
We have been working together with the Football Club Simulator - FCS community for the last twelve months preparing a main update driven by the gamers suggestions.
 
Now it's finished, and it's what we all wanted. And it's integrated with SteamWorks!!!
 
We have set in €10 the new official price of Football Club Simulator - FCS and launched a 50% offer coinciding with the Final of the football season. 
 
This is the summary of the most important improvements and innovations that we've been including with all of your suggestions:
 
Football Club Simulator - FCS 3.4.1 + DLC w17 + Mod 17 PCFutbolmanía

 
1. General
 1.1 UI improvements
We have expanded the screen area dedicated to key data by more than 20% using graphics rather than text to be able to easily access the essential information to make the best decisions at a glance.
 
 1.2 XML Data structure
The videogame's closed data structure has been replaced by an open and standardized XML format. Stability, therefore, has been improved immediately, and the Community will be able to Mod the game easier and faster than ever.
 
 1.3 Optimized performance
The code and its bottlenecks have been optimized especially in competitions, with 40% improvement in performance that has reduced to only 24 seconds daily and up to 105 seconds between season and season.

 
2. Competitions
 2.1 2016/2017 Season updated
This update comes with the DLC w17, updated with the winter transfers on January 31st of the seven countries with playable teams: Spain, England, Germany, Italy, France, Mexico, and Argentina.
 
And of course, also players from more than 30 countries with teams you can face in different competitions.
 
 2.2 SteamWorks
You also have SteamWorks to share and play with Mods created by the community all over the world. In addition to now having an XML data structure, creating Mods will be faster and more effective than ever. 
 
 2.3 Mod 17 PCFutbolmania
"Native" FCS Mods have arrived, with XML data structure and 100% compatible. The first one is the Mod 17 of PCFutbolmania and is now available. It is a great step forward. 

 
3. Playstyle
 3.1 Lineup with real-time training
The Lineup includes all the essential data: position, role, dorsal, name, nationality, skills, fitness condition, average, moral, tiredness, real-time average, average per position, age, play level, trophies ...
 
And as a novelty, the listing is interactive and allows you to decide in real time the most appropriate training for each of your players in just a few seconds. Try it. It is really useful. 
 
 3.2 New tactics and formations editor
Choose between the favorites of the best coaches in the world. You have seven predefined ones at your disposal. Use the simple and powerful editor to create your custom tactics and save it for your key matches. You have up to 5 "slots" for you to test your formations. 
 
 3.3 New markings
The screen "See rival" evolves into "One-on-one defense". You can study your rival and compare the average quality, the offensive and/or defensive balance and skills, fitness condition, morale and fatigue of each of his players. And here comes the key moment to decide which player or players you need to assign a one-on-one defense to "stop them" during the match. 

 
4. Market and signings
 4.1 Official and real-time transfers
The official transfers" mode has no limits of negotiation. As in real football, you can negotiate with players and teams throughout the season, incorporating the players only during the official windows:
 
Summer window = July 1st to August 31st.
Winter window = January 1st to January 31st
 
Also in Football Club Simulator - FCS you have exclusive of the "Real-time transfers mode". An agile, demanding and fun system, where you can sign, but also "'lose" players throughout the season. Dare to try it?...
 
 4.2 New market system and signings
Average, age, position, the difference of objectives of the competing teams ... absolutely everything is contemplated in the new salary calculation algorithms, clause, and transfer value to give the transfer and player market great realism.
 
 4.2 Football school
The youth team becomes an authentic "School of football" where you can train and study the evolution of the young players day by day and discover young promising players. If you spend time preparing and selecting players, it won't be long until you discover its advantages. For each young promising player you discover, the money you'll save in signings, the potential of sports results and the income increase will not just increase but it'll go through the roof!!!

 
5. Club and Stadium
 5.1 New distribution of TV rights
Finally, the majority of competitions have already agreed to a more fair system for the distribution of TV rights and similar in the major European football leagues. The system is now available in FCS and you can check how it increases the competitiveness in "Primera división" and provides greater liquidity to "Segunda división", which really needed it.  
 
 5.2 Assistant coach and coaching staff
Your collaborators are integrated into specialized staff and all of them together is your new "Coaching staff". It will not be cheap. But it will be essential to achieve your goals. If you know how to manage them, it won't be a loss. It will be your biggest investment.
 
 5.3 Extra funding for the stadium expansion
The improvement and expansion of your stadium is key to strengthen your finances and achieve your goals. Up until now, the works were paid by the bank, the deadlines were short and, of course, with "annoying" interests. 
 
The question for any Club owner is inevitable. How can I improve this situation?... Simple, if the manufacturer wants the contract, he will have to accept new deadlines for payment delayed until after the works have ended...

notes.title: Football Club Simulator - FCS 4.0.2.1 = Focused on stability. Update now available!!!
notes.notes:
The FCS 4.0.2.1 version of Football Club Simulator is focused on getting the best stability of the videogame and the competitions included.

To do this we have counted with the invaluable help of thousands of players from the International Community of FCS.

Players from Brazil to Germany, from England to Russia and from Spain to all countries of Latin America.

Without your reports, saved games, DxDiag and dump files it wouldn't have been possible to achieve such an improvement in so little time.

Many thanks to all.

Nataly Stefano - [url=] https://www.facebook.com/nataly.stefano 
Worldwide CM - The Football Club Simulator Studio 


STABILITY

General:

1.Fixed the "marking" by default of the country in the drop-down list of the player selection window.

2. Fixed the automatic alignment which now, if required, chooses youth players in replacement of injured and/or cautioned players.

3. Fixed the message when renewing your own player.

4. Limited to three the number of goalkeepers that a computer controlled team can handle.

5. Fixed the error at the end of the first season when playing in Pro-Manager mode.

6. Fixed the error when selecting a team at the end of season in Leagues of countries with "Cup 2": England, France, Mexico and Argentina.

7. Fixed the error when displaying the offers tab in the transfers window.


European competitions:

1. Fixed error when performing the group draw of the European Cup.

2. Fixed the error when ordering the groups of the Europa League.

3. Fixed the error when performing the draw of the round of 16 of the Europa League.

4. Fixed the error when getting the number of available places for non EU-Players.

5. Fixed error in the schedule of the english league so two matches aren't played on the same day.

6. Fixed error in the spanish Cup so the away and home games of the round of 16 aren't played both in the same stadium.

7. Fixed the error in the day 33 of the League of Italy that allowed to play two games in the same day.

8. Fixed the error of positions in the classification of the League of France concerning the Europa Cup and the Europa League.

9. Fixed the error in the name of the player "Rena" of the team "Paris" who appeared with incorrect characters.


American competitions:

1. Fixed the error in the schedule of the League of Mexico at the end of the regular season in the Apertura and Clausura tournament which allowed two games on the same day to be played in the promotion and relegation "Play-Offs"

2. Fixed the line-up in the trophies of the 1st and 2nd division of Mexico.

3. Fixed the qualifying of the best second team to the round of quarterfinals of the Mexican Cup.

4. Fixed the name of the player "Oliver" of the team "Mexico City" with incorrect characters.

5. Fixed the line-up in the Trophy of the 1st. division of Argentina.

IMPROVEMENTS

1. Counter-Offers to players in last year contract. Emotion in the signing until last minute

A new algorithm for the signing of players in the last year of contract manages and takes into account up to six variable for the calculation of a possible counter-offer and retention of the player by his current team:
 
The variables are the following: 
1. Signing offer
2. Clause offer.
3. Age of the player
4. Quality of the player
5. Average quality of the current team.
6. Average quality of your team.

Note: Try it out and give us your opinion to adjust it and improve it.
Write to Nataly Stefano: mail@footballclubsimulator.com

2. All or nothing. The promotion and relegation Play-Offs are here for Mexico and Argentina

Now we are risking the season in the field. And there is no need to rely on a "confused" calculation of averages of classification in the last 4 years.

The "Play-Offs" in real time are finally here, where the emotions get high when gambling the promotion and/or the relegation in the leagues of Argentina and Mexico. Get the victory in the field and not through bureaucracy.

In addition, we have updated the names of the groups to "Apertura", "Clausura" and "Final" so that everythign is clearer. And also the name of the competition "South Cup" which created a lot of questions, for the "Liberty Cup" one.

3. Get the maximum performance of your team. Manage foreigners and non-EU players up to the limit allowed

FCS already manages the official boundaries of foreigners in Argentina and Mexico and the non-EU players in Europe. Both the total in team as the total in the field.

This way, you will have clear how to do the line-up and the signings throughout the season in order to have the most competitive team.

notes.title: Football Club Simulator - FCS 4.0.2.1 = Focused on stability. Update now available!!!
notes.notes:
The FCS 4.0.2.1 version of Football Club Simulator is focused on getting the best stability of the videogame and the competitions included.

To do this we have counted with the invaluable help of thousands of players from the International Community of FCS.

Players from Brazil to Germany, from England to Russia and from Spain to all countries of Latin America.

Without your reports, saved games, DxDiag and dump files it wouldn't have been possible to achieve such an improvement in so little time.

Many thanks to all.

Nataly Stefano - [url=] https://www.facebook.com/nataly.stefano 
Worldwide CM - The Football Club Simulator Studio 


STABILITY

General:

1.Fixed the "marking" by default of the country in the drop-down list of the player selection window.

2. Fixed the automatic alignment which now, if required, chooses youth players in replacement of injured and/or cautioned players.

3. Fixed the message when renewing your own player.

4. Limited to three the number of goalkeepers that a computer controlled team can handle.

5. Fixed the error at the end of the first season when playing in Pro-Manager mode.

6. Fixed the error when selecting a team at the end of season in Leagues of countries with "Cup 2": England, France, Mexico and Argentina.

7. Fixed the error when displaying the offers tab in the transfers window.


European competitions:

1. Fixed error when performing the group draw of the European Cup.

2. Fixed the error when ordering the groups of the Europa League.

3. Fixed the error when performing the draw of the round of 16 of the Europa League.

4. Fixed the error when getting the number of available places for non EU-Players.

5. Fixed error in the schedule of the english league so two matches aren't played on the same day.

6. Fixed error in the spanish Cup so the away and home games of the round of 16 aren't played both in the same stadium.

7. Fixed the error in the day 33 of the League of Italy that allowed to play two games in the same day.

8. Fixed the error of positions in the classification of the League of France concerning the Europa Cup and the Europa League.

9. Fixed the error in the name of the player "Rena" of the team "Paris" who appeared with incorrect characters.


American competitions:

1. Fixed the error in the schedule of the League of Mexico at the end of the regular season in the Apertura and Clausura tournament which allowed two games on the same day to be played in the promotion and relegation "Play-Offs"

2. Fixed the line-up in the trophies of the 1st and 2nd division of Mexico.

3. Fixed the qualifying of the best second team to the round of quarterfinals of the Mexican Cup.

4. Fixed the name of the player "Oliver" of the team "Mexico City" with incorrect characters.

5. Fixed the line-up in the Trophy of the 1st. division of Argentina.

IMPROVEMENTS

1. Counter-Offers to players in last year contract. Emotion in the signing until last minute

A new algorithm for the signing of players in the last year of contract manages and takes into account up to six variable for the calculation of a possible counter-offer and retention of the player by his current team:
 
The variables are the following: 
1. Signing offer
2. Clause offer.
3. Age of the player
4. Quality of the player
5. Average quality of the current team.
6. Average quality of your team.

Note: Try it out and give us your opinion to adjust it and improve it.
Write to Nataly Stefano: mail@footballclubsimulator.com

2. All or nothing. The promotion and relegation Play-Offs are here for Mexico and Argentina

Now we are risking the season in the field. And there is no need to rely on a "confused" calculation of averages of classification in the last 4 years.

The "Play-Offs" in real time are finally here, where the emotions get high when gambling the promotion and/or the relegation in the leagues of Argentina and Mexico. Get the victory in the field and not through bureaucracy.

In addition, we have updated the names of the groups to "Apertura", "Clausura" and "Final" so that everythign is clearer. And also the name of the competition "South Cup" which created a lot of questions, for the "Liberty Cup" one.

3. Get the maximum performance of your team. Manage foreigners and non-EU players up to the limit allowed

FCS already manages the official boundaries of foreigners in Argentina and Mexico and the non-EU players in Europe. Both the total in team as the total in the field.

This way, you will have clear how to do the line-up and the signings throughout the season in order to have the most competitive team.

Note: There are still some errors to find in player with double nationality. If you find any player in this situation, send us a "screenshot" and we will fix it right away.
Write to Nataly Stefano: mail@footballclubsimulator.com
